# required-field-nullable-column

- Dialects: mysql, postgres, sqlite
- Default: on

## Why

The model promises a value is always present, so the application skips null handling. Only a NOT NULL column makes the database enforce that promise; otherwise another writer or a bug can store null and break the assumption later.

## Fix

Keep the field required in the model and make the column NOT NULL: regenerate the migration from the model, backfill existing nulls, and apply it.

## Exception

A column that is intentionally filled in a second step, for example by a backfill job, while the model is already stricter; write the reason down and remove the exclusion afterwards.

The same text is printed by `schemalens explain required-field-nullable-column`. An exclusion needs a written reason. Back to the [rule index](README.md).
